description:
Problem. get_instructions(expect_store=...) matches a case-insensitive SUBSTRING of the bound remote (documented in the todo skill). With two projects whose names share a prefix, the gate cannot tell them apart: observed 2026-11-09 on tractable 1.0.0 with a server bound to https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/benchbox-sqlglot.git#todo-state, expect_store='BenchBox-dev/BenchBox' was ACCEPTED (it is a prefix of 'benchbox-dev/benchbox-sqlglot'), so the 'wrong tracker' refusal that protects every first write silently passes. expect_store='BenchBox-dev/BenchBox.git' was refused correctly. Impact: an agent that follows the skill literally (pass the full owner/repo) can write core work into the fork tracker, or fork work into core, with no gate. Both repos exist and both have trackers, so this is a live hazard here, not a hypothetical.

Change (product: tractable, plus the todo skill). Make the match segment-aware: compare normalized owner/repo path segments (strip scheme, host, trailing .git) for equality, or require the expected value to match a whole path component. Keep accepting a bare repo name or full URL. Until then the skill should tell agents to pass the repository with a '.git' suffix or the full URL.
